Method of Attack: The package contains a preinstall hook that executes bucky.js, which enumerates the environment and sends data to a remote actor.
It performs system checks to avoid certain conditions before executing malicious actions.
Data is sent to a remote service using an HTTP request, with the URL path including the NPM package name.
Impacted Systems: Bucky Client project owned by HubSpot
Any system that installs this package and has environment variables or critical information like AWS access keys
Attack Vector: Installation of the malicious package via NPM
Execution of the preinstall hook in the package.json file
Indicators of Compromise: Environment variables being enumerated and sent to a remote actor
Use of a custom base64 encoding function (asB64) to obfuscate data
